name: my-info-canada
description: Conversational guidance and read-only tools for estimating relevant Government of Canada personal information banks.

interface.shortDescription: Estimate relevant federal personal information banks
interface.longDescription: Guides a privacy-minimizing questionnaire and uses structured, read-only tools to estimate which Government of Canada personal information banks may be relevant and whether records may still be held.
interface.defaultPrompt: Guide me through the My Info questionnaire.
